title: Kayak Hanalei
specs: Each participant must be in good physical condition.
Participants must be able to get in and out of their kayak on their own: no exceptions.

We welcome surfers ages 5 years and up and offer both private and group surf lessons.

services.name: RENTALS
services.desc: Stand Up Paddle Board Rental Special, $45 each Stand Up Paddle boarding (aka SUP) OR kayaking are super fun ways for all experience levels and ages to get out on the water. Paddle on the Hanalei River for a safe, fun & unforgettable kayak or sup experience in beautiful Hanalei! Hanalei River is great for both beginners and expert paddlers. If you are looking for a peaceful and tranquil paddle, this is it! Head upstream to the historical Hanalei Bridge and venture into the Hanalei Wildlife Refuge, or head downstream towards Hanalei Bay where you can pull up on the beach. You can't go wrong PRIVATE DOCK LAUNCH

services.name: Surf/ SUP Lessons
services.desc: Our Hawaiian family takes great pride in sharing the sport of He’e Nalu (surfing or sliding on a wave) with you. All levels are welcome and all surfing lessons are two hours in length. Hanalei Bay is a great beginner friendly beach for surfing lessons. Join our Hawaiian family for a safe, fun & unforgettable surf experience at the amazing sandbars of Hanalei Bay. The waves are perfect for beginners and usually, the participant will be able to touch bottom. We welcome surfers ages 5 years and up and offer both private and group surf lessons. services.name: Afternoon Bay Explorer
services.desc: Slip back in time. Experience the feeling of old Hawaii. Our completely personalized and narrated tours of the beautiful Hanalei River, the only river on Kaua’i where no commercial motorized boats are allowed, and Hanalei Bay, the largest natural bay on Kaua’i, all begin at our quaint shop in Hanalei Town. Learn about Kauai’s rich history, legends, and folklore from your friendly and knowledgeable guide. Visit the home of the Hawaiian green sea turtle and snorkel amongst the beautiful reefs exploring the abundant marine life, followed by a relaxing lunch on a secluded beach. No kayaking Afternoon Kayak Tour • 4 Hrs • Ages 5+
